:::{#rem-deriv-normsq-scalar}
#### Like the derivative of $x^2$

This vector derivative is like taking the derivative of $x^2$:
in scalar calculus $\deriv{x} x^2 = 2x$,
and @cor-deriv-normsq says $\deriv{\vcoef} (\dprod{\vcoef}{\vcoef}) = 2\vcoef$.
For example, with $p = 1$ and $\vcoef = (\coef{1})$,
$\dprod{\vcoef}{\vcoef} = \coef{1}^2$,
and its derivative is $2\coef{1} = 2\vcoef$.

:::
